flags.why: Dám does not mean ‘to weep’ or ‘to cry’; this is an invented sense ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/d%C3%A1m)).
Bàn meaning a game of chess is dated or dialectal, so presenting it without a warning misleads learners about ordinary usage ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0n)).
Bàn counts goals, not general points scored in sports ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%C3%A0n)).
The common meaning ‘to last or continue’ is missing and cannot be understood from ‘to pull’ ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/k%C3%A9o)).
flags.fix: verb | to last; to continue — Buổi họp kéo đến chiều. = The meeting lasted until the afternoon.

flags.why: The common meaning ‘to pawn’ is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%E1%BA%A7m)).
flags.fix: verb | to pawn (leave an item as security for a loan) — Anh ấy cầm chiếc xe máy để vay tiền. = He pawned his motorbike to borrow money.
